stories.title: Ubisoft's FOR HONOR will block SteamOS / Linux players starting September 10
stories.groq_label: Ubisoft's FOR HONOR will block SteamOS/Linux players despite Easy Anti-Cheat fully supporting Linux.
stories.groq_discussion:
Discussion type: – Community Perspective:

The Hacker News community generally responded to Ubisoft's decision to block SteamOS/Linux players in For Honor with negative reactions. Many commenters appreciated Linux gaming advancements and considered Ubisoft's move a step backward, highlighting how modern Linux gaming (via Proton) has become seamless and reliable. Others criticized Ubisoft's decision as unnecessary, especially given that some anti-cheat systems (like Easy Anti-Cheat) support Linux. Recurring criticisms focused on Ubisoft's history of poor decisions and anti-consumer practices, with commenters vowing to avoid Ubisoft games in the future. As a whole, commenters viewed the decision as an unpopular and regressive move, acknowledging Linux gaming's progress while expressing frustration with Ubisoft's stance on platform support.
